morphology.formula: ∅ + speedy → speedy（作为未加马来语词缀的英语整词处理）；英语内部构词：speed + -y → speedy
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留speedy为马来语分析层面的整词。英语内部可拆为speed与形容词后缀-y；ee读/iː/，末尾y读/i/，重音在第一音节。英语派生词族不等于马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】快速的；迅速完成、发生或及时作出的。
senses.en_definition: Moving, happening, or being done quickly; prompt.
senses.ms_definition: Kata adjektif bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud cepat, pantas atau segera, mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 本条解释英语形容词及其在夹杂英语的马来语交流中的用法；输入未提供DBP马来语释义。以下搭配本身是英语，不能标作规范马来语搭配。正式马来语通常按语境使用cepat、pantas或segera；speedy recovery可表达为cepat sembuh或kesembuhan yang segera。[Cambridge：speedy](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/speedy)。

collocations.en: a quick recovery from illness or injury

dual_scenarios.context: 职场语言说明；以标准马来语解释英语表达
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam surat rasmi bahasa Melayu, ungkapan Inggeris speedy recovery boleh digantikan dengan ucapan semoga cepat sembuh.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在正式马来语书信中，英语表达speedy recovery可以改用semoga cepat sembuh，意为“祝早日康复”。
dual_scenarios.en: In formal Malay correspondence, the English expression speedy recovery can be replaced with semoga cepat sembuh, meaning 'wishing you a quick recovery'.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友探病；夹用英语祝福语
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah keluar hospital? Speedy recovery, ya! Rehat dulu kat rumah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Awak sudah keluar dari hospital? Semoga cepat sembuh. Berehatlah dahulu di rumah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 出院啦？祝你早日康复！先在家好好休息。
dual_scenarios.en: Are you out of hospital? Wishing you a speedy recovery! Get some rest at home.

etymology.historical_story: Speedy has a history within English, rather than an established Malay derivational history. Merriam-Webster traces it to Middle English spedi, built from sped and an adjective-forming suffix. Earlier meanings included being beneficial, agile, or prompt, while the base also concerned success and progress. Modern speedy emphasizes quick movement or accomplishment, which helps explain the familiar wish for a speedy recovery. [Merriam-Webster：speedy](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/speedy).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: speed＝“速度”，加英语-y变成speedy＝“快速的”；整组记speedy recovery＝“早日康复”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉英语的朋友或同事之间，夹用speedy recovery可以表达关心。面对主要使用马来语的长辈或收件人，Semoga cepat sembuh更容易理解。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语正文宜使用合适的马来语表达；引用英语原话时可保留speedy。探病祝福中的“快”是美好愿望，应配合体谅和休息建议，避免让对方感到被催促康复。
